R1D-deer-walk-0006.name: 1.9 km NE of Oktwanch River
R1D-deer-walk-0006.pressureWhy: No town, pavement or rec site within 1 km and not behind a closure (estimate).
R1D-deer-walk-0006.parkWhat: pull off on Fl Rd(20840-23750) (gravel road)

evidence.t: Mule deer winter range u-1-014 unit P01d (official), right here. Counts from October.
Cutblock harvested 2006 (20 years old), 430 m S.
Burn from 2022 (fire V82198, 84 ha), 810 m NE.
Habitat zone Coastal Western Hemlock (CWHvm2): coast forest, where black tailed deer are among the most common large mammals (95%) and use logged ground often (80%) (lesson: Wet forests).
SW facing slope, 17 degrees: sun melts snow first.

seasonRows.notes: On Denman and Hornby Islands the season is Oct 5 to Dec 10. Part of MU 1-6 (Map A26) is 2 point or better; keep antlers with the species licence

Bow Only. no bow only season on the Gulf Islands in MU 1-1 (except Gabriola Island), in zone B of MU 1-5 (Map A12) or on Denman and Hornby Islands (MU 1-6). Part of MU 1-6 (Map A26) is 2 point or better
LEH (Limited Entry Hunting): draw only, not a general open season
No row in the Region 1 table, so no general open season (page 5: open seasons are only those in the synopsis). Mountain quail: printed 'No open season on mountain quail'.

plan: Drive: from City of Campbell River, about 82 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 49.90172, -126.17675, pull off on Fl Rd(20840-23750) (gravel road). Map links below.
Walk: 1.8 km NE, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 463 m, about 83 min at 3 km/h.
Hunt: deer, Aug, Sept, Oct, Nov, Dec (season rows). Watch the edge of the 2006 cutblock (430 m S) at first and last light. Sit above it with the wind in your face and glass (Tip).
Use: your .308 Winchester with a 150 to 165 grain expanding bullet (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 1-9, Region 1. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-09, closures 2026-10-16.
R1D-deer-walk-0006.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 1-9: about 1,374 hunter days a year for mule deer and white tailed deer (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.57 days per square km, middle third of BC MUs; access: average access. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).

tags.label: Beginner friendly
tags.why: Quieter spot only 1.8 km from the parking: fewer hunters, short walk back (Tip, estimate).

tags.label: Good for 2
tags.why: Cover edge here (cutblock or burn): one hunter sits at a crossing or glasses, the other walks the edge slowly with the wind at their back toward the stander. Agree zones of fire, a meeting point and a time at the truck (Tip, lesson: Hunting with a partner). Pushes are on foot only (99%, synopsis page 11, item 25).

R1D-grouse-atv-0003.name: 220 m W of Magee Creek
R1D-grouse-atv-0003.pressureWhy: Busier: within 1 km of a paved road (estimate).
R1D-grouse-atv-0003.parkWhat: where the truck road ends (Head Bay FSR); unload the ATV (all terrain vehicle)

evidence.t: 100% of the stretch in grouse forest zones (BWBS, CWH, ESSF, ICH, IDF, MS, SBPS, SBS).
5 cutblocks touch the road (30 years old or less): edges and clover.
8 wetlands, lakes or creeks along the road: riparian edges.

seasonRows.notes: sooty (blue) and ruffed only; 5 each (15 each); no open season on Denman Island (page 20)
sooty (blue) and ruffed; Bow Only; 5 each (15 each); no bow only season on the Gulf Islands in MU 1-1 (except Gabriola Island), in zone B of MU 1-5 (Map A12) or on Denman and Hornby Islands (MU 1-6)
No row in the Region 1 table, so no general open season (page 5: open seasons are only those in the synopsis). Mountain quail: printed 'No open season on mountain quail'.

plan: Drive: from City of Campbell River, about 82 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 49.80635, -126.14121, where the truck road ends (Head Bay FSR); unload the ATV (all terrain vehicle). Map links below.
Ride: the unnamed road stretch, 3.0 km one way. About 60 min one way at 3 km/h.
Hunt: grouse, Aug, Sept, Oct, Nov, Dec (season rows). Walk slowly in the first and last 2 hours of light. Watch where cutblocks and creeks meet the road (Tip).
Use: .22 rimfire for a sitting grouse inside 25 m (27 yd), or a shotgun with lead 6 or 7.5 (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 1-9, Region 1. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-09, closures 2026-10-16.
R1D-grouse-atv-0003.popWhy: Popular (more hunters): MU 1-9: about 2,167 hunter days a year for all big game (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.90 days per square km, middle third of BC MUs; access: close to pavement, a town or a rec site. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).

tags.label: Good solo
tags.why: Short pack out: 0.0 km and about 0 m of climb from the parking (Tip). Cell coverage is not in the data: leave a trip plan and carry SOS or a satellite messenger (lesson: Bush safety).
